reference.title: Instalações de ar-condicionado — Sistemas centrais e unitários — Parte 3: Qualidade do ar interior
reference.note: ABNT NBR 16401-3:2024 is treated as a contextual standard reference for HVAC-related IAQ and ventilation topics. This record preserves the 24-hour temporal limitation required by the consolidated dossier.

parameterDefinition.name: PM10
parameterDefinition.description: Respirable particulate matter mass concentration. The consolidated ABNT NBR 16401-3:2024 criterion is a 24-hour mean reference.

criteria.methodNote: ABNT NBR 16401-3:2024 consolidates PM10 as a 24-hour mean reference of 50 µg/m³. Instantaneous readings are observational and do not constitute 24-hour compliance.
criteria.temporalGuidance: A current reading may indicate an elevated environmental condition, but a 24-hour compliance result requires the corresponding observation period.

curation.curationNotes: Curated from the consolidated dossier. PM10 is retained as a 24-hour mean reference and is not represented as an instantaneous threshold.

validation.validationNotes: The consolidated dossier confirms PM10 = 50 µg/m³ as a 24-hour mean reference. Independent primary-source validation remains pending.
